releases.change: A replaced meal's spared animals are never bred: their good days (pain-free days, at the reader's two settings, both 0% by default) come off the shared per-meal figure in the 11 meal models; nothing moves at the defaults.

The people and animals a result adds: a death averted, a stillbirth averted, a year of contraception, an income raised and a future kept are read with the births parents forgo, the survivor's descendants and the animals all of them eat, by the beneficiaries' income group; nothing moves by more than 0.2% at the defaults.
Lives that never start count times a slider, 0% by default (the suffering in them always counts); future generations are the first rows it weighs, so the discount rate is time preference only.
A day of disabling pain is as bad as losing 10 hours of healthy life by default (was 9.6), near GBD's migraine attack and most severe back pain.
New checks: INV-9c (later-years benefits move with the discount rate), INV-24 (side-effect rows are tagged), INV-3's switch on days built from SADs; no model changes.

Side effects in imported models are tagged so the side-effects slider reaches them: GiveWell's excluded effects and additional benefits (components where a total includes development effects), household spillovers in HLI's and SoGive's models (split out where folded into a total), Fortify Health's harm adjustment and NEEV's rebound.
Follow-up of later-benefits-discount: RICE's lower-cost KMC development share and GiveDirectly's December 2023 sheet's developmental effects rescale to your discount rate.

Benefits that come years later move with the discount rate: GiveWell's typed-in development effects, deworming and malaria income present values and development shares rescale to your rate (later_benefits in link-givewell-shared.py); TLYCS dispensers' income share rescales like the other readers; HLI's GiveDirectly splits recipient and household (a side effect) and is discounted over the years the effect lasts.
AMF's 2023 DRC sheet: the pasted total after leverage/funging becomes the computed total times the sheet's ratio, so side effects, the value of a child's life and the discount rate reach its result.

ACE's 2026 SADs carry no species weight (AIM v2): Greener by Default takes the shared species step with @aim_sads.<s>_2026 = 1, so the Rethink Priorities toggle is read and its evaluator view counts ACE's SADs as SADs.
Spending is recorded, never guessed: #spending needs a figure from accounts or the evaluator's model; wavg has no fill; Clear Solutions and ACTRA, with neither, leave the weighted average.
A charity with no spending on record weighs the median of the others in the same weighted average (wavg), not its cause's median.
Ambitious Impact's average of its charities weighs each by programme spending (#spending:<charity>); #cause:x stays equal-weight, and 2.8 says why.
Rules text: Animal Policy International's import rules carry the EU cage-free egg-import cost.
Cause aggregates (#cause:x) leave out what the rankings leave out, purely theoretical models included.
Purely theoretical models are shown but never ranked.

Versioning starts: the rules and audit skill as of this date. Every model whose audit passed on its current content is stamped 0.1.0; each earlier rule change (credit-switch-co-funders, mobiliser-share-imports, mobiliser-share-30) was applied to every model.
